title: Add TUI goal display tests
objective: Define lightweight TUI visibility for active /goal without redesigning the interface.
context: Codex surfaces active goals as task state; Claude shows an active goal indicator.
This project should show a compact status only, not a new panel.

source_evidence.note: SlashCommandEntry powers suggestions from registered commands.
TUI slash entries are generated from command registry metadata.

include: Test /goal appears in slash suggestions via registry metadata.
Test active goal renders a compact indicator such as goal: active.
Test long objectives are truncated safely.
Test no-goal state leaves status unchanged.
exclude: Do not add a modal or new panel.

implementation_steps: Add slash suggestion test for goal command metadata.
Add status render test using current TUI status helper.
If no status helper exists, add a small test around the render function closest to status bar text.
deliverables: Failing tests for compact TUI goal display.
acceptance_criteria: Tests do not require terminal snapshots.
Long text cannot overflow the status area.
risks: TUI tests may be brittle if they assert full rendered lines.
dispatch_prompt: Add failing tests for compact TUI /goal visibility: slash suggestions, active indicator, truncation, and unchanged no-goal state. Do not implement UI.
notes_for_assignee: Prefer pure render/helper tests over full terminal snapshots.
